## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 and claim-2 are grounded, but neither establishes the required rectangle-attachment identity.
- claim-3 remains unsupported. Formula (R) is only proposed; no termwise map from the accepted full-coordinate Hopf identity is defined, and no proof verifies its endpoint coefficients, lower-attachment terms, or boundary cases.
- The graded-kernel presentation proves independence of the lower family but does not determine coordinates of the right-adjoined class. The finite \((2,3,2,2)\) computation cannot prove the universal equation.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Define the rectangle-attachment map explicitly and prove termwise that it sends the accepted full-coordinate Hopf identity to
  \[
  s_{(i^j,\rho)}-(-1)^{|\rho|}s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}
  =\sum_{\sigma\subsetneq\rho}F_{\rho,\sigma}s_{(i^j,\sigma)},
  \quad F_{\rho,\sigma}\in\Lambda_{|\rho|-|\sigma|},
  \]
  including both endpoint coefficients, padding, \(b=j\), \(\rho=\varnothing\), and \(a=0\); alternatively provide an admissible exact counterexample to the stated equality in \(Q\).
